title: Sentiment marks rebuilt (Option A SVG) + tab bar icon-above-label fix
summary: Replaced incoherent Unicode sentiment glyphs (◎/◌/○) with three custom 24×24 SVG components — Sentiment / on (filled disc + ring), Sentiment / middle (ring + inner dot), Sentiment / off (ring only) — all at consistent 1.75px stroke, token-bound to ink-3-aaa (default) and ochre-link (selected). Selected-state affordance added: 2px ochre-link bottom border on active cell, label shifts to ink. Applied to App 04 (On track selected) and App 07 (Energized selected). Tab bar fixed across all 13 app screens: reordered to icon-on-top, label-below; added missing Home label on App 01; swapped Tasks double-checkmark (checks) for list-check icon (three rows with tick marks, reads as task list not completed). Inheritance model discrepancy noted: tab bars were plain frames, not component instances — fix applied directly to all 13 frames plus the source component.

changes: Reordered all tab cells: icon first (index 0), label second (index 1)
Added missing Home label to App 01 Tab/home (was icon-only, height 40px)
Normalized all tab cell heights to 49px, itemSpacing to 4px (Spacing/xs)
Swapped Tasks icon: checks (double-checkmark) → list-check (3-row list with ticks)
tabBarFix.inheritanceNote: Tab bars are plain FRAME nodes, not instances of component 12:6655. Fix applied directly to all 13 frames. Source component also fixed as canonical reference.

contrastPairs.pair: ochre-link bottom border stroke (non-text) on paper-warm

accessibility.targetSize: Sentiment option cells 110-120px wide × 72-80px tall — well above 44pt AAA comfort threshold
accessibility.o1Status: advanced — incoherent set replaced with token-bound SVG set at AAA contrast; selected-state affordance adds non-colour differentiation
